title: Business Analyst Learning Path
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines the first-30-day BA learning path.
details: The path covers requirements, process modelling, stakeholders, data and delivery practices.
Learning combines modules, examples, shadowing and practice.
Questions should be recorded for manager checkpoints.
escalation: Raise a Training or Manager Support ticket if support is unavailable.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
